title: serving-weekly-prep-jordan-notes
content:
Weekly Serving + Infra + Console Sync — prep scratchpad (working)
Date: 2025-03-06
Time: 10:00–11:00 PT (50m + 10m parking)
Location: #team-serving-runtime huddle / Zoom (link in calendar)
Attendees (expected): Jordan T (me), Anya R, Michael C, Priya P (infra), Sasha L (console), Omar (SRE)
Pre-reads: PR 421 (runtime perf fixes), INFRA-482 (node scaling proposal), CON-88 (canary rollback logic)

Goals for this week
- Quick alignment across serving runtime, infra, and console on rollout timeline for v1.9.2 (aiming for 3/14)
- Triage perf regression on long-tail seqs (p95 spikes) and agree on short-term mitigation
- Decide whether to enable the new autoscaler flags for Dedicated pools in prod next week

Agenda rough (50m)
1) 10m — Quick status round (each team 2–3 bullets)
   - runtime: PR421 merge window, perf numbers post-quant/patch
   - infra: autoscaler sim results, capacity reservations for Dedicated customers
   - console: rollout dashboard tweaks, canary metrics availability
2) 15m — Perf regression triage (owner: Jordan / Michael)
   - show p50/p95/p99 for seq len buckets (0–128, 129–512, >512) — I will paste latest numbers
   - short-term mitigation options: enforce max-seq clamp at gateway; temporary KV-cache bypass for >512 seqs; revert new attention kernel if needed
   - open question: enable seq-clamp for only hosted API vs Dedicated? (ops cost vs customer impact)
3) 10m — Autoscaling decision (owner: Priya)
   - infra asks for go/no-go to flip flag that reduces cooldown from 180s -> 60s for Dedicated pools
   - show simulated tail latency impact and cost delta (Priya: bring sim table)
4) 10m — Console canary + rollback plan (owner: Sasha)
   - current canary metrics (error rate, latency) stale by ~7m — need to tighten refresh cadence or add alerting
   - discuss UX fallback: manual rollback vs auto-fallback on SLO breach
5) 5m — Action items + parking lot

Notes to self / prep checklist (do before meeting)
- Pull latest perf dashboard snapshot (Grafana) and export p95 numbers for three seq buckets — save image to the doc.
- Re-run small reproducer for p95 spike with model-variant q4 (branch: quant-eval) on a 2xA100 test pool. Capture logs.
- Add brief bullet for customers impacted (list from incident-runbook filter): Dedicated-cust A, Hosted-app B.
- Ping Priya for autoscaler sim CSV + cost assumptions (need by EOD 3/05).
- Confirm Sasha has the canary retention logs and alert thresholds (cc: @sasha).

Current quick metrics (snapshot, copy-paste from dashboard)
- Global token throughput: 1.2M tokens/min (last 24h avg)
- p50 overall: 85ms; p95 overall: 480ms (up from 360ms last week)
- p95 by seq bucket: 0–128: 220ms; 129–512: 610ms; >512: 1.8s
- Error rate (500s) 24h: 0.12% (mostly timeouts on >512 requests)

Immediate suspects / hypotheses
- New attention kernel (PR421) has edge-case with KV reuse on >512 leading to lock contention
- Autoscaler cooldown too long, so cold starts during bursty traffic increasing tail latency
- Console metrics pipeline laging — we might be making decisions off delayed data

Quick mitigation proposals (pros/cons)
- Enforce gateway seq clamp at 1024 for hosted API only (pros: fast; cons: customer-visible truncation)
- Toggle kv-cache-bypass for >512 seqs to avoid kernel path (pros: reduces lock contention; cons: increases compute cost)
- Rollback PR421 to previous kernel until we have a patch (pros: stable; cons: we lose perf gains on short sequences)

Open questions to raise in sync
- How many Dedicated customers actually send >512 seq requests regularly? (ask CS to surface usage)
- If we reduce autoscaler cooldown to 60s, what is the expected cost delta for Dedicated pools at 95th percentile traffic? (Priya)
- Is console able to provide <2m freshness for canary metrics if we change ingestion cadence? (Sasha)

Parking lot (defer if time runs out)
- Expand regression test harness: add 3 long-tail prompt templates to nightly CI
- Evaluate cache-key sharding to reduce contention on KV cache under >512 sequences

Action items (working table)
- Jordan: paste perf snapshots and reproducer logs into this doc; prepare a 2-slide before/after perf chart. Due: 2025-03-05. status: in_progress
- Michael: run debug build with lock-instrumentation on quant-eval branch and share flamegraph. Due: 2025-03-07. status: todo
- Priya: upload autoscaler sim CSV + cost delta table; recommendation: enable cooldown=60s in staging by 3/07. Due: 2025-03-05. status: requested
- Sasha: confirm canary metric refresh cadence options and whether console can push <2m freshness. Also, prepare fallback flow doc for manual rollback. Due: 2025-03-07. status: todo
- Anya: reach out to CS and get list of Dedicated customers with >512 seq usage (anonymous counts ok). Due: 2025-03-06. status: todo
- Omar (SRE): rehearse emergency rollback runbook for runtime kernel revert; be ready to trigger with 30m notice. Due: 2025-03-08. status: todo

Notes to self: keep this doc as living scratchpad — I’ll copy cleaned agenda to shared_drive/engineering/serving-runtime/agenda once finalized. After meeting: move action items to Jira (SERVE-1297 sub-tasks) and add owners.

End of scratchpad.
